chunks: Those who disbelieved and denied Our signs - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide eternally therein, and evil is the destination.
ai.seo_question: Who are the inhabitants of Hell according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the finality of divine judgment for those who not only disbelieved but actively rejected clear proofs (Ayat), linking their denial to an eternal abode in Hellfire. The phrase 'bi'sa al-masir' (evil destination) serves as a poignant conclusion, emphasizing that the journey of the disbelievers ends in a wretched state, a theme often contrasted with the 'good destination' of the faithful. This description aligns with the broader Shia understanding of *Adl* (Divine Justice), where eternal punishment is a direct consequence of persistent rejection of truth.
